observations: Two black gaming consoles are shown side-by-side in photo 0.
The consoles feature the PlayStation logo on the front and the PlayStation button symbols on the back.
The units appear to be the standard 4K Ultra HD model rather than the Pro model.
The consoles are resting on a wooden surface with a colorful abstract painting in the background.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'WILCOX HARRY' are visible across all photos.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a standard 4K Ultra HD model, not the Pro model.
This is a marketing claim that cannot be verified remotely.
